description.value: The Station Pub is a casual bar and kitchen in Invermere, BC, serving burgers, fish and chips, sandwiches, and American fare. It sits on 6th Avenue in the heart of the Columbia Valley, a popular region for cycling the Kootenay Rockies. The patio and full kitchen make it a natural mid-ride stop for cyclists exploring the valley.
